import os,json
D='/home/USER/runs/paper/glm-hpl0d1-u1-ceiling/frozen/seen-2/play/users/u032/system/state/workspace/programs'
os.makedirs(D,exist_ok=True)
prog='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    hr = [i for i, r in enumerate(grid) if len(set(r)) == 1]
    hc = [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1]
    rb = [0] + [x + 1 for x in hr] + [h]
    cb = [0] + [x + 1 for x in hc] + [w]
    cells = [v for r in grid for v in r]
    bg = max(set(cells), key=cells.count)
    from collections import Counter
    cnt = Counter(cells)
    anomaly = max((c for c in set(cells) if c != bg), key=lambda c: cnt[c]) if len(set(cells)) > 2 else None
    # anomaly = color that is neither background nor separator
    seps = set()
    for i in hr: seps.add(grid[i][0])
    for j in hc: seps.add(grid[0][j])
    anomalies = [c for c in set(cells) if c != bg and c not in seps]
    anom = anomalies[0]
    out = []
    for bi in range(len(rb) - 1):
        row = []
        for bj in range(len(cb) - 1):
            n = sum(grid[i][j] == anom for i in range(rb[bi], rb[bi+1]) for j in range(cb[bj], cb[bj+1]))
            row.append(1 if n == 2 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
